title: Change class taxonomy
description: Law-declared closed vocabulary of change classes (ADR-GOV-0017). The taxonomy document at law/policy/change-taxonomy.json declares, for each class, its family, the check members it engages, the constitution Article 6 authority row it maps onto, and the class pairings a single commit may carry. A separate binding document (the law default under law/policy/adopter-defaults/change-taxonomy-binding.json, the adopter copy at .devai/config/change-taxonomy-binding.json) assigns paths to classes with ordered selector entries. A binding may only assign paths to the classes declared here; it may not add, rename, or merge classes. Every tracked path resolves to exactly one class: two bindings that match the same path are a policy load error, never a precedence rule, and declaration order carries no meaning beyond presentation.

class_name.description: The closed class vocabulary. A binding may reference these names only.

family.description: Commit hygiene family. Governance paths and implementation paths never share a commit unless a declared pairing allows it.

check_member.description: A member name accepted by the check adapter switch in packages/cli/src/commands/check/adapters.ts.

repository_path.description: Repository-relative path without a leading slash, backslash, or NUL.

check_members.description: Check members a change of this class engages. May be empty for classes whose verification is a script rather than a check member.

constitution_authority.description: The law/constitution.md Article 6 authority-by-path row this class maps onto. The taxonomy never contradicts that table.

kind.description: exact compares the whole path; prefix compares a leading substring; glob uses the check-runner glob grammar (* within a segment, ** across segments, ? one character).

bindings.description: Ordered entries of {selector, class}. The order is presentational only: every path must be matched by at most one entry, and a loader that finds two entries matching one path (two prefixes where one extends the other, an exact path under a prefix, or a glob that reaches a bound path) fails with an overlap error instead of choosing the earlier or the later entry.

binding_document.description: Shape of a binding file. The taxonomy field names the law policy whose class vocabulary the bindings must use.

classes.description: One declaration per class; the key set equals the closed enum exactly.

pairings.description: Class pairs a single commit may carry. Any pair not listed is a commit hygiene violation under ADR-GOV-0018.

bindings.description: Where the path-to-class bindings live and how overlap is treated. The binding entries themselves live in the referenced documents, validated by #/$defs/binding_document.

law.description: Constitution, decision records, policy sources, glossary, and trace.

plan.description: Campaign plans, round plans, product records.

code.constitution_authority: packages/ and root workspace configuration — Engineer (F2)

ci.constitution_authority: Host-tool configuration directories — path fixed by the toolchain

toolchain.description: Root workspace configuration and pinned dependency identity.
toolchain.constitution_authority: packages/ and root workspace configuration — Engineer (F2)

generated.description: Generated views and materialized policy copies.

pairings.reason: The action registry and its generated views must co-commit.
